verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms convertible notes/SAFEs exist as objects on Carta's cap table and can be queried via API (carta-docs-21, carta-docs-30, carta-docs-10), implying they are modeled once created, but there is no documentation in this pack of an in-platform workflow to draft, send, or e-sign a SAFE/convertible note (only a 'Draft Issuer API' and 'draft option grant' creation flow are mentioned, not draft convertible notes or e-signature). Missing for 10: evidence of SAFE/convertible note creation and e-signature workflow, evidence that terms auto-model conversion scenarios upon signing.
